# Call Center Staffing

> Worldwide call center staffing agency. We supply trained call-center agents to your business — agents stay on OUR payroll and you pay only for hours worked. Onshore (US), nearshore (Mexico, Colombia), offshore (Philippines, India, South Africa). Founded 2003. 100,000+ trained agents. Deploy in ~72 hours. 90-day attrition guarantee. Month-to-month.

Call Center Staffing (callcenterstaffing.net) supplies trained inbound, outbound and blended call-center agents — plus supervisors, QA, WFM, trainers and operations leadership — to client businesses worldwide. Agents remain on our payroll, so clients carry no HR, training or termination burden; clients pay only for hours worked, can swap any agent free, and are covered by a 90-day attrition guarantee. Buyers are operations, CX, and HR leaders and founders at in-house contact centers, CX teams, regulated firms (healthcare, finance, insurance) and growing SMBs/startups — across the US, UK, Canada, Australia and other English-speaking markets. We are NOT a BPO/call center ourselves; delivery geographies (Mexico, Philippines, Colombia, India, South Africa) are where agents work, not where buyers are.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2003
- Trained agents to date: 100,000+
- Typical deployment: ~72 hours
- Engagement model: pay only for hours worked; month-to-month
- Guarantees: swap any agent free; 90-day attrition guarantee
- Delivery: onshore, nearshore, offshore
- Work types: inbound, outbound, blended; B2B and B2C

- [Why us](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/why-us): Agents on our payroll, pay per hour worked, free agent swaps, and the 90-day attrition guarantee.

## Solutions

- [Scaling an Existing Call Center](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/scaling-existing-call-center): Backfill attrition, ramp seats and protect SLAs with continuous recruiting at your forecast cadence.
- [Launching a New Call Center](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/launching-new-call-center): Greenfield builds onshore, nearshore or offshore — from first 25 to first 250 seats on your launch calendar.
- [Seasonal & Surge Staffing](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/seasonal-surge): Pre-built bench for Q4, open enrollment, tax season and product launches. Ramp on schedule, demobilize cleanly.
- [Direct-to-Employer Staffing](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/direct-to-employer): Hires placed directly into in-house contact centers, with senior-recruiter screening and 90-day attrition guarantees.
- [Compliance & Licensed Roles](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/solutions/compliance-licensed): NMLS, state-insurance, HIPAA and PCI-cleared agents for healthcare, financial services and insurance teams.

## Locations (delivery)

- [Mexico](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/locations/mexico): Bilingual call-center agents in Guadalajara, Mexico City and Monterrey, with CT/ET overlap and onshore-grade quality.
- [Philippines](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/locations/philippines): Native-English call-center agents in Manila, Cebu and Davao, with 24/7 coverage and mature CX infrastructure.

## Roles

- [Bilingual Call Center Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/bilingual-agents): Bilingual agents across onshore, nearshore and offshore markets; tested for accent neutrality, fluency and CX skills.
- [Inbound Customer Service Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/inbound-customer-service): Inbound agents at scale, screened for empathy, AHT discipline and first-call resolution.
- [Outbound Sales Agents](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/outbound-sales-agents): Outbound agents screened for tonality, objection handling, conversion discipline and CRM speed across B2C and B2B.
- [Team Leads & Supervisors](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/team-leads-supervisors): Supervisors screened for shrinkage discipline, coaching skill and adherence — not just tenure.
- [QA Analysts](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/qa-analysts): QA analysts screened for inter-rater agreement, root-cause analysis and coaching follow-through.
- [Workforce Management](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/workforce-management): WFM analysts, real-time analysts and managers screened for forecast accuracy, intraday discipline and Erlang fluency.
- [Trainers & QA Coaches](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/trainers): Trainers and coaches who shorten ramp and lift week-4 quality scores.
- [Operations Managers](https://www.callcenterstaffing.net/roles/operations-managers): Ops managers screened for P&L literacy, leadership cadence and span-of-control discipline.
